notes:
The Sharing screen no longer says your visibility choice comes from Settings. It never did any more: the Private / Unlisted / Public picker on that screen is what both "Upload now" and "Schedule for later" use, and a scheduled clip keeps the title, description and visibility you chose at the time you scheduled it. Only the wording was wrong, in all five languages, and it is now correct.

The YouTube logo is no longer faded. A platform tab with no clips in it was drawn dimmed, and that dimmed the official YouTube mark along with it. The tab still looks quiet when it is empty, but the mark itself is now always shown at full strength, the way YouTube's brand guidelines require.
